name: @activepieces/piece-gorgias
description: Helpdesk platform for ecommerce teams to manage tickets, customers, and support conversations.

auth.description:
To connect your Gorgias account:

1. Copy your helpdesk subdomain (for example, `acme` from `https://acme.gorgias.com`).
2. In Gorgias, create or copy an API key.
3. Use the email address associated with that API key.

Authentication uses HTTP Basic auth with `email:api_key`.

domain.description: Your Gorgias subdomain only, for example `acme` from https://acme.gorgias.com.

email.description: The email address associated with your Gorgias API key.

create_gorgias_ticket.name: create_gorgias_ticket
create_gorgias_ticket.description: Create a new Gorgias ticket with an initial message.

fromAddress.description: The sender address for the initial message, typically the customer email.

toAddress.description: The recipient address for the initial message.

message.description: Initial ticket message. HTML is accepted by the API.

aiMetadata.description: Open a new support ticket in Gorgias seeded with one initial message, specifying the sender (from) and recipient (to) addresses, subject, body, and the channel/via the message came through. Use to start a fresh conversation rather than reply to an existing thread; to add a follow-up message to a ticket that already exists, use Create Message instead. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate ticket.

get_gorgias_ticket.name: get_gorgias_ticket
get_gorgias_ticket.description: Retrieve a Gorgias ticket by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Gorgias support ticket by its numeric ID. Use when you already have the ticket ID and need its current details; to discover tickets without an ID, use List Tickets first. Idempotent read-only lookup.

customerId.description: Optional customer ID to attach to the ticket.

customerEmail.description: Optional customer email to attach alongside the customer ID.

fromAgent.description: Whether the first message of the ticket was sent by your company.

aiMetadata.description: Modify fields on an existing Gorgias ticket identified by its numeric ID, such as subject, status (e.g. open/closed), channel, attached customer, spam/unread flags, or external ID. Use to change ticket state or metadata; this does not add a reply or message (use Create Message for that). Idempotent: it sets fields to the supplied values, so repeating the same call leaves the ticket in the same state.

list_gorgias_tickets.name: list_gorgias_tickets
list_gorgias_tickets.description: List Gorgias tickets with cursor-based pagination support.

customerId.description: Optional customer ID to filter tickets for one customer.

cursor.description: Optional cursor returned by a previous list response.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return in this page. Defaults to 25.

aiMetadata.description: List Gorgias support tickets, one page at a time, with optional filtering by customer ID and custom ordering. Use to discover or enumerate tickets when you do not have a specific ID; pass the cursor from a prior response to page through results. Idempotent read-only query.

create_gorgias_ticket_message.name: create_gorgias_ticket_message
create_gorgias_ticket_message.description: Create a reply or message on an existing Gorgias ticket.

fromAgent.description: True when the sender is an agent/user; false when the sender is a customer.

senderId.description: User ID when From Agent is true, otherwise Customer ID.

receiverId.description: Customer ID when From Agent is true, otherwise User ID.

fromAddress.description: Email or channel address of the sender.

toAddress.description: Email or channel address of the receiver.

message.description: Message body. HTML is accepted by the API.

sentDatetime.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for when the message was sent.

aiMetadata.description: Append a new message (reply) to an existing Gorgias ticket identified by its numeric ID. The From Agent flag controls direction: when true the message comes from an agent/user (Sender ID is a user, Receiver ID a customer), when false it comes from the customer (the IDs swap). Use to continue an existing conversation; to open a brand-new ticket use Create Ticket. Not idempotent: each call appends another message.

get_gorgias_customer.name: get_gorgias_customer
get_gorgias_customer.description: Retrieve a Gorgias customer by ID or find one by email.

customerId.description: Use this when you already know the customer ID.

email.description: If Customer ID is not provided, search customers by email using Gorgias server-side filtering.

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single Gorgias customer, operating in one of two modes: pass a Customer ID to fetch it directly, or omit the ID and pass an Email to search customers server-side and return the match. Use to resolve a customer record before working with their tickets; supply exactly one of the two inputs and the call errors if neither is given or no email match is found. Idempotent read-only lookup.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
